dispatch_notes: zai glm-5.3 rate-limited (429) under 7-way concurrency; wave recovered via serial re-dispatches (acceptance r1b, architecture r1c, codebase r1b, tests r1b, edge r1b). All 7 lenses delivered valid JSON.

rejected_detail.title: Vector2Length transcendental
rejected_detail.reason: sqrt is IEEE-754 deterministic, not a transcendental; in-code comment cites the draw_path_offset_band precedent already in the raster path

rejected_detail.title: Reveal envelope never reaches k=1
rejected_detail.reason: smoothstep easing by design; residual 2% at last live tick is imperceptible; expiry-to-identity is the standard envelope

blockers.title: Pipe-highlight radius mixes units: tile-space dx/dy tested against 8*tile_px — every pipe on the map pulses
blockers.detail: Radius guard compares tile-unit squared distance against (8 x tile_px)^2 = 208 tiles — no pipe on a 40x30 map is ever excluded. Golden-verified: spawn_feel/04000ms pulses pipe 1-3 whose midpoint sits 9.8 tiles from the spawn (intended bound: 8). Network-wide flash instead of the documented neighborhood feedback; baked into the re-blessed goldens.
blockers.recommended_fix: Drop the * v.tile_px (compare pure tile units) or multiply dx/dy by tile_px; re-bless spawn_feel captures.

blockers.title: Pending-commands predictor pin is vacuous — its draw is span-invalid and is rejected identically on both sides
blockers.evidence: pending := []pp.Command{{kind = pp.Cmd_Draw_Pipe{a = 0, b = 3, tier = 1}, apply_tick = 77}}  // node0(10,10)->node3(34,15): span 25 > standard max_span 14 -> Span_Exceeds_Tier
blockers.detail: The pinned draw never materializes (span 25 > 14), so live and shadow sides stay identical and the assert 'pending draw must move the prediction' is a tautology. The load-bearing pending mechanism is unpinned while the test claims to cover it. Same cause silently rejects sfx_fixture's own 1->3 pipe (span 23 > 14).
blockers.recommended_fix: Use the real harness fixture positions (res(8,15), rt(20,15), host(32,15), placed router (34,15)) so the 1->3 draw is span-exact 14 = valid; assert the pipe exists after apply.

warnings.title: Reduced-motion disables the pipe highlight entirely, contradicting the documented 'steady band'
warnings.detail: File header + PR body promise 'the highlight is steady' under E9.2 (pulse_read precedent: presence, not motion); the code early-returns. Ring and reveal keep their static readings — the highlight alone loses presence.
warnings.recommended_fix: Draw the steady band at fixed alpha when reduced_motion instead of returning.

warnings.title: Type-chip hairline fade reintroduces the rlsw line-alpha trap during the reveal
warnings.detail: The software renderer ignores line alpha, so golden captures render the hairline solid through the reveal while the GPU app fades it — app and goldens visually diverge for 8 ticks per spawn. The pre-change code deliberately kept this line full-alpha.
warnings.recommended_fix: Keep the hairline full-alpha (as before) or draw it as filled rects.

warnings.title: spawn_fx_init/spawn_fx_destroy are dead code; reveals latches the ambient allocator and is never torn down — 3,318 tracker leak lines added to the render suite
warnings.detail: No call sites anywhere; View.spawn_fx zero-inits and the buffer self-allocates on first append via the ambient allocator, never freed. Adds 3,318 tracker leak lines to odin test app/render (the same noise class the PR's growth_test fold cleaned from core).
warnings.recommended_fix: Wire init/destroy into the View lifecycle (app init + harness ctx), or delete the procs and document the latch-on-append pattern.

warnings.title: shadow_clone completeness guard cannot catch future non-serialized dynamic fields; a miss frees live sim memory
warnings.detail: The round-trip pin covers only hash-visible (serialized) state. A future [dynamic] field missed by the clone leaves the clone aliasing the live array; run_destroy(&shadow) then deletes the LIVE sim's buffer. Today the clone is field-for-field complete (verified against every sub-struct).
warnings.recommended_fix: Extend the pin to walk field metadata, or add a construction-time assert/comment contract naming every dynamic field.

warnings.title: Reveal-buffer >4 trim boundary has no test
warnings.detail: The bounded-buffer trim (pause/catch-up bursts must not grow reveals unbounded) is unexercised; ordered_remove appears nowhere in the test file.
warnings.recommended_fix: Feed 5+ NODE_SPAWNED events in one slice and assert len(reveals) == 4.

warnings.title: Reduced-motion telegraph ring and highlight draw paths untested
warnings.detail: Only the reveal's reduced-motion pin exists; the static-ring and (currently disabled) steady-highlight branches have no automation, so the W1 doc/code divergence is invisible to the suite.
warnings.recommended_fix: Pin the reduced-motion ring draw (static radius/alpha) and highlight behavior once W1 is fixed.

notes.title: PR body mis-describes the node_health 20000ms re-bless as carrying 'the ring burst' — no telegraph can exist in that golden
notes.detail: At t400 the harness predict targets window 480 (lead 80 > 10) and the t400 telegraph was never predicted (prior capture t200 also predicts nothing) — the frame carries reveal + highlight only. The re-bless itself remains justified.

notes.title: Placement feedback highlights neighborhood pipes vs the spec's 'connecting pipe' — documented, defensible interpretation
notes.detail: A fresh spawn has no pipes; the PR body documents the estate-neighborhood reading. Superseded in practice by B1 (the filter is ineffective anyway).

notes.title: sfx_fixture is not 'the growth.dem recipe' it claims — different base positions and its fixture pipe is silently rejected
notes.detail: Harness fixture: (8,15)/(20,15)/(32,15); test uses (10,10)/(12,10)/(14,10) and its 1->3 draw (span 23 > 14) is dropped silently, so the tests run on a pipe-less topology. The pins still hold (clone/predict exactness is fixture-independent) but the comment lies.
notes.recommended_fix: Adopt the harness fixture positions (also fixes B2).

notes.title: sfx_load_cat declares an allocator parameter the body never uses
notes.detail: read1 + catalogs_load use context.allocator regardless; all callers pass context.temp_allocator in vain. Cosmetic API dishonesty in a test helper.

notes.title: Predictor detects spawns via next_node_id delta — a pending Cmd_Place_Router inside the lead window plus a rejecting growth plan would telegraph the router
notes.detail: Theoretical today: both callers pass only already-applied commands (app {}, harness action_log past-only). The API surface allows the misuse.

notes.title: Dedup-reset branch in spawn_fx_predict is unreachable
notes.detail: predicted_window can only equal `window` when lead <= 10 for that window; lead never grows within a window, so the reset never fires. Dead defensive code.

notes.title: Pointless '_ = before' no-op in the feed test
notes.detail: `before` is used two lines below in the slice expression; the discard is leftover noise.

notes.title: Telegraph timeline guard wraps when terminal_spawn_interval_ticks < 10
notes.detail: T - SPAWN_LEAD_TICKS underflows u64 for tiny windows; unreachable at the shipped 80-tick cadence (catalog floor is >= 1), but a modded catalog could hit it.

notes.title: Bad-free fix is unverifiable by test; the 2 remaining bad frees are pre-existing in health_test.odin
notes.detail: Verified by Perkins: exactly 2 bad frees in `odin test core`, both in health_test.odin lines 877/910 — a file this diff does not touch.

notes.title: App-side predict glue (Run-mode gate, per-frame dedup, topology-gen re-predict) is never exercised by automation
notes.detail: Goldens cover the harness force path; the app dedup/gen-retarget logic in main.odin has no automated coverage.

notes.title: Render package now owns a field-by-field Run_State deep copy and executes pp.step in the view layer
notes.detail: Layering tension vs ODN-1's spirit — documented and deliberate per the PR body's decision table (core-side prediction rejected as a sim-semantics change); recorded as accepted risk, not re-litigated per round orders.
